population: simulated customer borrowers with one designated index loan and complete observation/follow-up
window_provenance: scenario assumptions; not recovered collection dates or contractual tenure
index_time: day 0; history strictly earlier; outcomes strictly later through day 60

split.test_role: one final evaluation per preregistered scenario/seed; never select settings from test
split.refit_policy: no train+validation refit in v2; freeze chosen train-only fitted pipeline

outcome.primary: no simulated principal or interest repayment in the future window
outcome.secondary: future penalty or no future repayment
outcome.reference_use: historical proxy scenario only; original follow-up was variable, unlike proposed fixed horizon
outcome.sensitivity_provenance: 2% and 8% are scenario assumptions; center is archived cohort proxy
outcome.generation: P(no_repayment|z)=sigmoid(intercept+beta*z); conditional on repayment, penalty probability=92392/(51105+92392); labels derive from realized lifecycle events

background_events.provenance: computational scenario assumption, not recovered activity frequency
background_events.sampling: filtered raw candidate shares as explicit scenario reference only
background_events.loan_events: separate lifecycle; do not draw using raw loan-type frequency

amount_distribution.provenance: scenario assumption; not fitted to global amount mean

background_events.balance_distribution: omitted; no balances, fees, tax or affordability claims

direction_and_counterparties.counterparty_sampling: uniform local synthetic pool per borrower; no cross-borrower network
direction_and_counterparties.provenance: scenario assumptions, not inferred account directions

background_events.timestamp_distribution: iid Uniform[-90,0), sorted by (time,event_id); reject ties at index
background_events.history_loan_events: none in v2; exactly one designated index loan
background_events.shared_history: same latest K eligible events for static and sequence models; K from profile

scenarios.history_link: history independent of latent risk and outcome streams
multiply base history amounts by exp(0.35*z), then clip; z~N(0,1) is simulator-private common cause

permute complete (amount,category,direction,counterparty) payloads across fixed times within shared latest-K history; z>=0 ascending amount, z<0 descending; preserve multiset and defined static aggregates exactly

execution.model_selection_status: existing implementations; small GRU configuration still needs wiring
execution.cv: optional later: 3 folds on 60% train partition only, each with fresh 15% inner early-stop split; validation/test untouched
execution.budget_enforcement: planning limits; instrumentation and runtime enforcement not implemented
execution.class_weight_policy: balanced from inner-training labels only; report unweighted probability metrics

randomness.streams: separate named streams for background, latent risk, outcomes, event timing, splits and model initialization; history invariant to outcome RNG changes
randomness.calibration: generator intercept determined on independent 100000-draw standard-normal reference with seed 1042; bisection to expected reference prevalence; never use realized evaluation outcomes or model performance; record intercept and convergence

loan_lifecycle.no_repayment: no repayment event through day 60; penalty absent in v2
loan_lifecycle.repaid_without_penalty: one full principal repayment at Uniform(1,30) days; no penalty
loan_lifecycle.repaid_with_penalty: penalty at Uniform(31,45) days; repayment at Uniform(penalty_day,60] strictly after penalty
loan_lifecycle.label_policy: derive from future events linked to designated loan; sampled latent/outcome state is not a feature or final label
loan_lifecycle.provenance: all lifecycle amounts/timings are assumptions; archived conditional timing percentiles are reference-only, not fitted targets

features.shared_history_rule: last K background events with -90 <= day < 0; gap first=0; ddof=0; static mean gap over actual successive gaps only (0 if singleton)
features.sequence_truncation: truncate before fitting scaler, float32, left-pad after transform; mask from explicit lengths; never infer missingness from zero-valued real events
features.counterparty_features: unique count only; raw identities never encoded

preprocessing.static: StandardScaler per allowlisted numeric column, fit inner-training borrowers only; fixed one-hot schema; reject missing/nonfinite unexpected input
preprocessing.sequence: StandardScaler only log1p_amount,gap_hours,relative_day on retained real timesteps of inner-training borrowers; binary and one-hot unchanged; pad zeros after transform; persist lengths and scalers
preprocessing.class_weights: fit inner-training labels only; same policy for all models; no whole-development class ratios
preprocessing.selection: inner-training scaler excludes early-stop/validation/test users; each CV fold has independent inner-fit preprocessing
preprocessing.heldout_perturbation_test: changing validation/test values or outcomes must not change fitted preprocessing or training tensors

cache.default: disabled for smoke; immutable raw arrays permitted for later runs
cache.mismatch: fail closed; never fall back to legacy caches; new run directory required
cache.format: numeric arrays + Unicode IDs; np.load allow_pickle=False; SHA256 arrays and JSON metadata; full shape/ID/label alignment check
cache.scope: transformed arrays partition/fold-specific; no cross-fold reuse

evaluation.threshold: 0.5 fixed for initial report; any later threshold selection uses validation only and is recorded
evaluation.calibration: none initially; later calibration uses validation only and is an explicitly separate analysis
evaluation.uncertainty: paired borrower bootstrap on locked test predictions, 1000 replicates, seed 42; resample same IDs across models, skip single-class draws and report count; no significance claim from smoke
controls: sequence-order shuffle within borrower (train and evaluate as separate experiment)
evaluation.validation_rules: all partitions need both primary classes; fail rather than silently alter seed/split; smoke performance is not an accuracy gate
evaluation.claim: controlled simulation comparison, not estimate of telco deployment performance
